fields.description:
Adds variants to a draft or running test. Running patch tests also create tracking snapshots
for the new variants and can enqueue screenshot capture work. Requires A/B testing create
access.
fields.name: abTestAddVariants

fields.description:
Changes the primary goal only when the test is draft or running. The goal must belong to the
same site and already have triggers. Passing the existing goal returns the current test
unchanged. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestChangeGoal

fields.description:
Validates the target page before create or update. May create or re-associate a site, returns
device availability, and reports whether the caller should replace the submitted site_id.
Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestCheckPage

fields.description:
Creates a draft A/B test after running the same page validation used by updates. Patch tests
default patch_strategy to async, create_snapshots enables per-variant tracking assets, and
patch variants can enqueue screenshot capture work. Requires A/B testing create access.
fields.name: abTestCreate

fields.description:
Soft-deletes a test and records analytics tracking for the deletion. Re-deleting an already
deleted non-variant-tracked test returns the current deleted test. Requires A/B testing edit
access.
fields.name: abTestDelete

fields.description:
Deletes a variant only while the parent test is still in draft. Unlike retirement, this
removes the variant instead of marking it retired. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestDeleteVariant

fields.description:
Clones a test and its variants into a new draft named as a duplicate, assigns fresh results
tracking ids, and returns only the new test id. Requires A/B testing create access.
fields.name: abTestDuplicate

fields.description:
Publishes a draft test. Patch tests require variants and create per-variant snapshots, while
split tests require at least one non-control variant with redirect URLs. Re-publishing an
already published test returns the current test. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestPublish

fields.description:
Retires a non-control variant on a draft or running test. For tests tracked by variant, this
also updates related snapshot status. Re-retiring an already retired non-variant-tracked
variant returns the current test. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestRetireVariant

fields.description:
Sets manual traffic weights and the auto_reweight flag for the stored variants. Also records
analytics with prior ratios and current result counts; failures are returned as a generic
adjustment error. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestSetTrafficSplit

fields.description:
Stops a running test. For tests tracked by variant, stopping also updates the related
snapshots. Re-stopping an already stopped non-variant-tracked test returns the current test.
Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestStop

fields.description:
Updates only draft tests. Re-runs page validation, refreshes stored draft metadata, and may
enqueue screenshot capture work for patch variants. Returns an error instead of partially
updating non-draft tests. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestUpdate

fields.description:
Updates only the draft payload for a draft test. This changes saved draft metadata without
revalidating the page or applying the full create/update pipeline. Requires A/B testing edit
access.
fields.name: abTestUpdateDraft

fields.description:
Updates existing variants on a draft or running test. Matching is by variant id only, and
patch variants can trigger screenshot recapture work after the update. Requires A/B testing
edit access.
fields.name: abTestUpdateVariants

fields.description:
Creates multiple draft tests by calling the single-create flow for each input in order. Stops
on the first failure instead of returning partial success. Requires A/B testing create access.
fields.name: abTestsCreate

fields.description:
Adds a site from its registrable domain, rejects duplicate or subdomain-only entries, enables
session recording for the new site, and returns the caller's full site list rather than just
the created site.
fields.name: addSite

fields.description:
Adds normalized tags to the accessible recordings. Tags are lowercased, trimmed, truncated,
and de-duplicated before insert, and the response returns one entry per normalized tag with
the count of recordings changed for that tag.
fields.name: addTagsToRecordings

fields.description:

fields.description: Publishes the saved add-on draft and its Audience atomically.

`status: deleted` instead of an error when the addon was already soft-deleted, and otherwise
returns a fresh preview token for the saved record.
fields.name: addonEdit

fields.description:
Toggles whether an existing survey or CTA is active. This updates the stored script state,
returns the resulting boolean, and marks a linked suggestion as used when one exists.
fields.name: addonEnabled

fields.description:
Creates a reusable survey or CTA template. This is restricted to callers with addon template
management access, and an uploaded thumbnail is stored before the template is saved.
fields.name: addonTemplateCreate

fields.description:
Deletes an addon template by id. This is a hard delete for the template record and returns

hosted Checkout). `paymentMethodId` is the freshly-entered card, or omitted to
reuse the customer's existing default card. `clientSecret` is non-nil only when
the first invoice's PaymentIntent needs authentication (SCA) — the client
confirms it before navigating to success.
fields.name: createSubscription

fields.description:
Deletes the logged-in account after confirming both `delete: "delete"` and the current guest
user id. For account holders this also kicks off account teardown side effects, including
subscription cleanup and a queued confirmation email.
fields.name: deleteAccount

fields.description:
Deletes linked team members or pending invitations for the logged-in account. Requires team
settings edit access, accepts mixed `ua_*` and `i_*` ids, and returns the ids that were
removed.
fields.name: deleteAccountUsers

fields.description:
Deletes a folder the logged-in user can edit and also removes its snapshot assignments in the
same transaction. Returns the deleted folder payload on success.
fields.name: deleteFolder

fields.description:
Deletes a saved site playlist and returns `true` on success. Recommended playlists are not
persisted, so passing one of their ids results in a not-found error instead of a delete.
fields.name: deletePlaylist

fields.description:
Soft-deletes the accessible recordings within the given site and returns the IDs actually
marked deleted. Fails when the site is not editable by the caller, and emits deletion tracking
for the bulk action.
fields.name: deleteRecordings

fields.description:
Soft-deletes the site by marking it deleted, then returns the caller's remaining accessible
sites. The mutation name is broader than the current behavior; associated data is not
synchronously removed here.
fields.name: deleteSiteAndAssociatedData

fields.description:
Soft-deletes snapshots instead of removing rows. Recurring chains that point at deleted
snapshots are detached as part of the mutation.
fields.name: deleteSnapshots

fields.description:
Disables API access for the logged-in user by clearing both stored API credentials. Returns
`true` only after the credentials are removed.
fields.name: disableUserApiCredentials

fields.description:
Duplicates eligible snapshots and stops the original snapshot first. Manual page camera
snapshots, recurring snapshots, flow variants, and snapshots already chained to a recurring
copy are skipped.
fields.name: duplicateSnapshots

fields.description:
Starts snapshot export jobs and returns the queued snapshot IDs, not download URLs. Including
`ai` in `views` requires JSON export permission in addition to CSV export permission.
fields.name: exportSnapshots

fields.description:
Creates a funnel for a site the caller can edit. `goalSteps` must reference goals the caller
can access and all goals must belong to the same `siteId`; when `visitStep` is true, the
funnel starts with an implicit page-visit step before the listed goals.
fields.name: funnelCreate

fields.description:
Soft-deletes every accessible funnel in `ids` and its associated steps. Nil and duplicate ids
are ignored, inaccessible ids are skipped, and the mutation reports only the funnel ids that
were actually deleted.
fields.name: funnelDelete

fields.description:
Replaces an existing funnel's definition for a site the caller can edit. The mutation
revalidates every `goalStep`, rewrites the funnel's step list from scratch, and returns
`Funnel not found` when the funnel is missing or outside that site.
fields.name: funnelEdit

fields.description:
Renames an existing funnel without changing its steps. Requires edit access to the funnel's
site and returns `Funnel not found` when the funnel is missing or inaccessible there.
fields.name: funnelEditName

fields.description:
Creates a goal for a site the caller can edit. Trigger filters are validated before any
records are written, the user's script is flagged for regeneration, a screenshot batch job is
queued asynchronously, and the response returns only the created goal id.
fields.name: goalCreate

fields.description:
Soft-deletes a goal the caller can edit. Its triggers are soft-deleted, linked A/B tests are
detached or deleted depending on status, related funnels are deleted, the user's script is
flagged for regeneration, and the response returns the deleted goal id.
fields.name: goalDelete

fields.description:
Updates an existing goal the caller can edit. The submitted `triggers` list is authoritative:
matching ids are updated, entries without ids are created, and existing triggers omitted from
the list are soft-deleted; the mutation also flags the user's script for regeneration, queues
screenshot capture asynchronously, and returns only the goal id.
fields.name: goalEdit

fields.description:
Renames an existing goal the caller can edit. The name is trimmed and must remain non-empty
after validation, and the response returns only the goal id.
fields.name: goalRename

fields.description:
Deletes an image only if it belongs to the logged-in user and returns a confirmation string on
success instead of the deleted image.
fields.name: imageDelete

fields.description:
Uploads one image for the logged-in user, normalizes most raster formats to fit within
1024x1024 before storage, and returns the stored image record rather than a background job or
upload receipt.
fields.name: imageUpload

fields.description:
Fetches each remote URL server-side, runs the same upload pipeline as `imageUpload`, and
returns the created images in request order. Failures during fetch or processing fail the
mutation instead of returning per-image partial results.
fields.name: imageUploadUrls

fields.description:
Starts the Segment install flow for a logged-in user with installation view access. The
provided return URL is signed into a redirect token and handed off to the integration service;
on success this returns the external redirect URL, and on any upstream failure it returns a
generic error.
fields.name: initializeSegmentIntegration

fields.description:
Records the playlist as recently used for the current guest. This accepts both saved and
recommended playlist ids, upserts the usage timestamp, and returns `true` even when the call
is a no-op for admin sessions.
fields.name: markPlaylistAsUsed

fields.description:
Creates a notification for a goal, survey, or site after confirming the caller has
`notifications:edit` access to the resource's site. This may create or reuse the backing
channel, and duplicate channel/resource/action combinations fail through the notification
changeset.
fields.name: notificationCreate

fields.description:
Soft-deletes the notifications the caller can edit and returns the affected ids. Zapier-backed
notifications are skipped here and are only removed when deleting their associated resource.
fields.name: notificationDelete

fields.description:
Updates an existing notification's delivery channel for the given site when the caller has
`notifications:edit`. The notification's current channel type is preserved, so only the
destination or chosen channel changes.
fields.name: notificationEdit

fields.description:
Bulk-enables or disables editable notifications and returns only the ids whose stored state
actually changed.
fields.name: notificationToggleEnabled

fields.description:
Marks a page camera snapshot as ready for screenshot processing after the user upload step.
Requires edit access to the snapshot, returns null on success, and only allows the transition
when the snapshot is waiting on user files unless `recapture` forces a reprocess.
fields.name: pageCameraSetScreenshotStatus

fields.description:
Checks whether the current user can publish changes for a page or version. If the editor is
still unclaimed it is assigned to the current user; otherwise the owner-notification email is
sent when access is missing.
fields.name: pageEditorCheckPermissions

fields.description:
Creates a page under an existing editor UUID or creates a new editor when editor_id is
omitted. Returns the editor UUID together with page thumbnail upload details.
fields.name: pageEditorCreatePage

fields.description:
Creates a new version snapshot for a page and returns the new version id plus presigned
thumbnail upload details; the response does not include the stored patch body.
fields.name: pageEditorCreateVersion

fields.description:
Grants a user access to edit or publish a page editor page/version. Requires owner-level edit
access, creates the target site/account access when missing, and sends the access email.
fields.name: pageEditorGiveAccess

fields.description:
Upserts brand-guideline JSON for an editor/site pair. This succeeds only when the editor is
unowned or the caller can edit page settings for the site.
fields.name: pageEditorSaveBrandGuidelines

fields.description:
Overwrites an existing version's patch, segment, and optional name, then returns thumbnail
URLs for the existing version instead of the updated version payload.
fields.name: pageEditorUpdateVersion

fields.description:
Validates whether a specific user can access a page or version using a signed token context.
It mirrors the permission check flow and sends a validation email only when access is allowed
but the user is not logged in.
fields.name: pageEditorValidateUser

fields.description:
Stops active snapshots that have already started. The result separates newly paused snapshot
IDs from IDs that were already stopped.
fields.name: pauseSnapshots

fields.description:
Publishes a version if the caller can edit page settings for the page's site. This also
unpublishes overlapping published versions for the same page and refreshes the install script
before returning the page's current versions.
fields.name: publishVersion

fields.description:
Queues a fresh automatic capture for each eligible snapshot by marking it for reprocessing.
Manual page camera snapshots are ignored.
fields.name: refreshSnapshots

fields.description:
Regenerates the public share code for an existing shared URL the caller can edit, invalidating
the previous link. When provided, `originalUrl` is replaced at the same time.
fields.name: regenerateSharedUrl

fields.description:
Bulk version of `regenerate_shared_url`. Missing or unauthorized IDs are skipped, and the
mutation errors only when none of the supplied URLs can be regenerated.
fields.name: regenerateSharedUrlList

fields.description: Rotates the site's API key and returns the updated site with the new key.
fields.name: regenerateSiteApiKey

fields.description:
Regenerates both API credentials for the logged-in user and returns the new key, secret, and
signature. Any previously issued API key and secret stop matching the stored credentials.
fields.name: regenerateUserApiCredentials

fields.description:
Removes normalized tags from the accessible recordings and returns one entry per normalized
tag with the count of recordings that actually lost that tag.
fields.name: removeTagsFromRecordings

fields.description:
Resends an invitation email for a pending invite in the logged-in account. Requires team
settings edit access, only works for invitation ids (`i_*`), and returns the same id when the
resend succeeds.
fields.name: resendInvitationEmail

fields.description:
Legacy resume mutation. Only stopped, unexpired snapshots that have remaining visit capacity
can resume, and the response returns only the affected IDs.
fields.name: resumeSnapshots

fields.description:
Resumes eligible stopped snapshots and returns partial success details. Ineligible or invalid
snapshots stay unchanged and are reported in `errors` instead of failing the whole mutation.
fields.name: resumeSnapshotsNew

fields.description:
Creates a playlist when `playlist.id` is omitted, or updates the existing site playlist when
it is present. The filter must parse to a non-empty recordings filter, recommended playlist
ids cannot be saved, and duplicate names may be auto-deduplicated before the saved playlist is
returned.
fields.name: savePlaylist

fields.description:
Creates or updates the current account's SAML SSO settings for users with the `sso:edit`
capability. When a non-admin enables SSO or changes key IdP/SP fields, the mutation returns a
5-minute validation token and preview payload instead of persisting the settings immediately;
otherwise it saves the record and returns `needsValidation: false`.
fields.name: saveSsoSettings

fields.description:
Queues an addon details request to support. `isCorporate` only changes the internal
subject/template context, not the recipient or authorization requirements.
fields.name: sendAddonDetailEmail

fields.description:
Queues install instructions to the provided developer email and can CC the logged-in user when
`ccMe` is true. Although `message` is nullable in the schema, blank messages fail validation
before the email is enqueued.
fields.name: sendInstallInstructionsEmail

fields.description:
Queues a priority support request for the logged-in user. The message is sent to support with
the supplied email as `replyTo`, while the actual sender is a server-side address.
fields.name: sendPrioritySupportEmail

fields.description:
Queues a logged-in user's feedback message to the internal help inbox using the account email
on their session. Returns validation errors for blank or oversized messages instead of sending
immediately.
fields.name: sendUsFeedbackEmail

fields.description:
Replaces the viewer's primary card with `payment_method_id` and returns the
refreshed card summary.
fields.name: setDefaultPaymentMethod

fields.description:
Replaces the logged-in user's enabled Google Analytics property set with the provided property
IDs. Requires `ga: import`, enforces the GA property limit against the unique IDs
submitted, queues GA import jobs for the submitted properties, and returns only properties
whose enabled state changed.
fields.name: setEnabledGaProperties

fields.description:
Creates or updates recording settings for the site. Rate-based sampling values are normalized
before persistence, and the change also triggers downstream recording ratio recalculation and
tracking.
fields.name: setRecordingSettings

fields.description: Stores up to the first 100 colors in the site's metadata and ignores any additional values.
fields.name: setSiteColors

fields.description:
Enables or disables session recording for a site. Requests that do not change the current
state return a validation error instead of silently succeeding.
fields.name: setSiteRecording

fields.description:
Stores per-user metadata. Most keys upsert the latest value, while event-style keys are
write-once markers; omitting `value` stores a key without a value.
fields.name: setUserData

fields.description:
Requires Crazy Egg email settings edit access. Only provided notification flags are upserted;
omitted flags keep their existing values.
fields.name: setUserNotifications

fields.description:
Soft-deletes one or more survey response groups for a survey. Requires logged-in survey edit
access, is idempotent for already deleted responses, returns the deleted response group IDs on
success, and returns a generic error when nothing matched.
fields.name: surveyResponseDelete

fields.description:
Switches the viewer's subscription to the Free/Free+ plan from the in-app cancellation
flow ("Switch to Free"). Paid plans keep access until the end of the current billing
period; trials switch immediately.
fields.name: switchToFree

fields.description:
Records click or view events for getting-started tasks in Metrex. Returns `true` only when
every requested slug is tracked successfully.
fields.name: trackGettingStarted

fields.description:
Unpublishes a version, updates the page script when publish state changes, and returns the
page's current versions rather than a single version record.
fields.name: unpublishVersion

fields.description:
Removes watched markers for the current guest viewer and returns how many watch rows were
deleted.
fields.name: unwatchRecordings

fields.description:
Bulk-updates linked team members and pending invitations for the logged-in account. Only
provided fields are changed; owners are always treated as account-wide, and permission checks
reject ids the caller is not allowed to modify.
fields.name: updateAccountUsers

fields.description:
Requires tracking options edit access. Normalizes the submitted IP list, saves the cleaned
text, syncs it to site settings, and returns inline validation or save errors instead of
failing the mutation.
fields.name: updateBlockedIps

fields.description:
Requires billing edit access. Updating any company address field triggers country-specific
address validation and also updates matching payment transaction company details.
fields.name: updateCompanyInfo

fields.description:
Updates the workflow status for an existing error fingerprint on a site. Requires the
`errors-edit` capability, fails with `Not found` when no summary exists for the fingerprint,
stamps the acting guest and current time server-side, and writes the status change into the
fingerprint's note history in the same transaction. Although `status` is nullable in the input
type, the resolver currently expects it to be present.
fields.name: updateError

fields.description:
Updates only a folder's title. The folder must belong to the logged-in user, be editable on an
allowed site, and snapshot-only folders are eligible for this mutation.
fields.name: updateFolder

fields.description:
Renames an existing site playlist and returns the final stored name. If the requested name
collides with another playlist, the backend may auto-deduplicate it by appending a copy-style
suffix.
fields.name: updatePlaylistName

fields.description:
Updates a shared URL's enabled/disabled state and note for resources the caller can edit.
Returns an error when the URL no longer resolves to an editable resource or when
`note`/`original_url` validation fails downstream.
fields.name: updateSharedUrl

fields.description:
Bulk version of `update_shared_url`. Each item is applied independently and the response only
includes successful updates; the mutation errors only when none of the supplied URLs can be
updated.
fields.name: updateSharedUrlList

fields.description:
Enables or disables the site's public tracking API. Turning it on also generates an API key
automatically when the site does not already have one.
fields.name: updateSitePublicTrackingApi

fields.description:
Updates tracking settings for a site, creating the underlying site_settings record first if
the site does not have one yet.
fields.name: updateSiteSettings

fields.description:
Updates one snapshot and returns validation failures in the payload. Some fields may be
ignored when the caller lacks permission to edit that aspect of the snapshot.
fields.name: updateSnapshot

args.description: Stripe proration timestamp from a prior preview, so the charge matches what was shown.
args.name: prorationDate

fields.description:
Updates either user-level settings or site tracking settings. Supplying `site_id` switches
this to a site settings update, maps `auto_identity` to the underlying `auto_identify`
setting, and follows the stricter tracking-options permission path; user-level updates refresh
the tracking script after success.
fields.name: updateUserSettings

fields.description:
Marks the given changelog events as seen for the current guest/session and returns whether any
new view rows were inserted.
fields.name: viewChangelogEvents

fields.description:
Marks a single recording as watched for the current guest viewer. Returns `true` after the
mutation runs rather than the persistence result, so inaccessible or skipped recordings do not
surface in the payload.
fields.name: watchRecording

fields.description:
Marks the accessible recordings as watched and returns how many view rows were inserted or
refreshed for the current guest viewer. Existing watch rows are updated in place instead of
duplicated.
fields.name: watchRecordings

types.description:
Cursor-based notification list payload. The cursor is derived from ids already seen, and
`has_next_page` only indicates whether the current page reached the requested limit.
types.name: NotificationsListMeta

types.description:
Sort options for notification lists. Defaults to newest first and supports derived keys such as
channel destination and joined resource name rather than raw notification columns only.
types.name: NotificationsListOrder

types.description:
Tracking-options container; selecting nested fields triggers capability-gated lookups instead of
returning stored data eagerly.

fields.description:
Links that switch cookie-based blocking on and off for the visitor's own browser on one site.
Null when the account's tracking script would not honour them.
fields.name: cookieBlockLinks

types.name: Options

types.description:
Permission snapshot used by page-editor sharing and publishing flows; `account_exists`
short-circuits the other fields when no account relationship exists.
types.name: PageEditorListPermissionsMeta

types.description:
One tracked page inside an editor; history is persisted raw and page-level lock or ignore state
is exposed as JSON-encoded strings.
types.name: PageEditorPageResponse

types.description:
Page editor loaded from an editor UUID, with nested pages and versions eagerly materialized
for the editor session.
types.name: PageEditorResponse

fields.description: A page speed page, which maps to the equivalent web page.
fields.name: id

types.description:
Metadata for page-based snapshot listings, including aggregate counts and legacy client flags
returned with every page.
types.name: PaginationMeta

types.description:
Billing plan metadata exposed to GraphQL with derived flags and a sanitized plan group value
when the underlying group is not public.
types.name: PaymentPlan

types.description:
Normalized billing-history entry returned by both list and detail queries. Some values are
derived rather than stored directly, including Unix timestamps, plan display names, and company
id/VAT copied from the current user profile.
types.name: PaymentTransaction

types.description:
Cursor-paginated billing-history payload; `has_next_page` is inferred from whether the page
filled the requested limit, and `next_page_cursor` carries the ids needed to exclude rows
already returned.
types.name: PaymentTransactionListMeta

types.description:
Sort options for the billing-history feed. When omitted, results default to `created_at`
ascending before cursor filtering is applied.
types.name: PaymentTransactionListOrder

fields.description: Stable key the shell resolves to a support URL; null for non-linked features.
fields.name: hrefKey

fields.description: Stable category key; the shell resolves it to an icon.
fields.name: key

fields.description: Stable feature key; the shell resolves it to a support URL when one exists.
fields.name: key

fields.description: Per-plan tooltip keyed by plan key; only present where a tooltip exists.
fields.name: tooltips

fields.description: Per-plan cell value keyed by plan key: boolean or display string.
fields.name: values

fields.description:
Returns the dashboard-focused A/B test inbox as a cursor-based list with optional site,
status, and search filters.
fields.name: abTestDashboardList

fields.description:
Returns conversion distribution buckets for a specific test and goal; the requested dates are
normalized against the test's available runtime before aggregation.
fields.name: abTestDistribution

fields.description: Returns the editor-focused A/B test payload without loading result metrics.
fields.name: abTestEditorDetail

fields.description:
Returns the most recent non-draft A/B tests for the active site context, defaulting to 3
items when no explicit limit is provided.
fields.name: abTestHomeRecent

fields.description:
Returns the A/B test inbox as a cursor-based list with optional site, status, and search
filters; visitor sorting is computed from merged results data rather than the base record.
fields.name: abTestList

fields.description:
Returns a page-based A/B test list for flows that need numbered pagination, including shared
goal views; `goal_id` filters the list and the date arguments scope the attached results data.
fields.name: abTestListPaginated

fields.description: Returns lightweight A/B test and variant references for selectors.
fields.name: abTestRefList

fields.description:
Returns goal/date/order-scoped result metrics for an A/B test using a normalized per-variant
counts shape.
fields.name: abTestResultCounts

fields.description:
Returns static/structural result-page data for an A/B test, including the canonical default
selected goal but excluding filter-scoped metrics.
fields.name: abTestResultDetail

fields.description:
Returns aggregate inbox counts by A/B test status for the current viewer, optionally scoped to
one site.
fields.name: abTestStatusCounts

fields.description:
Returns the account-level team roster for Team Settings, merging the account holder, active
guest users, and pending invitations behind the `team_settings.nav` capability gate.
fields.name: accountUsers

fields.description:
Returns the current JSON Schema contract and a representative content example for a Survey
or CTA. The revision identifies the exact vendored schema set used by mutation validation.
fields.name: addonContentContract

fields.description:
Returns one addon by id, including soft-deleted records when the request originates from
linked parent resolvers such as audit trail entries.
fields.name: addonDetail

fields.description:
Returns paginated surveys and CTAs visible to the current session, auto-narrowing the type
filter when the viewer only has one addon capability.
fields.name: addonList

fields.description:
Returns aggregate counts keyed by addon status after applying the same site and capability
filters used by addon list queries.
fields.name: addonStatusCounts

fields.description:
Returns one suggestion and marks it as clicked when it is still in an eligible suggestion
lifecycle state.
fields.name: addonSuggestionDetail

fields.description:
Returns recent suggestions for a site and marks them as viewed; `limit` defaults to 3 when
omitted.
fields.name: addonSuggestionsList

fields.description:
Returns one template by id or `null` when the template does not exist instead of raising a
not-found error.
fields.name: addonTemplateDetail

fields.description:
Returns the shared survey and CTA template catalog plus a top-level `can_manage` flag;
template management itself is restricted to addon template managers.
fields.name: addonTemplatesList

fields.description:
Returns the analytics dashboard for a site or GA property. Requires the web analytics view
capability, a date range, and only resolves the nested metric fields you request.
fields.name: analytics

fields.description:
Returns per-day goal conversions for the requested source and date range. Unlike `analytics`,
this query only returns the conversion series and does not include dashboard metrics.
fields.name: analyticsConversionsOverTime

fields.description:
Returns one ranked analytics dimension with its own cursor. The response normalizes the
selected dimension into the `dimension` field instead of echoing the dimension name in the
payload.
fields.name: analyticsDimension

fields.description: This is similar to an analytics dimension, but instead returns the over time results.
fields.name: analyticsOverTime

fields.description:
Returns the first enabled admin announcement; disabled records are hidden and absence resolves
to `null`.
fields.name: announcement

fields.description:
Returns API credentials for the current user, creating them on first access when the user can
manage the API.
fields.name: api

fields.description: Returns the pinned Audience definition contract and account targeting availability.
fields.name: audienceDefinitionContract

fields.description:
Returns a mixed audit log feed for the current session. Access requires the `audit_log:view`
capability, and some requested action types such as billing or install are satisfied by
matching `internal_url_visited` records behind the scenes.
fields.name: auditableActionList

fields.description:
Returns the saved billing profile for the current user, including sanitized payment details
and company addresses.
fields.name: billingDetails

fields.description:
Up to three all-time usage totals for the viewer's account, in the order the cancellation flow
should show them. Totals are account-wide and not filtered by site; display names, captions and
number formatting live in the shell.
fields.name: cancellationMetrics

fields.description:
Returns only the top-level capability fields requested in the selection set, so omitted
capabilities are never computed or included.
fields.name: capabilities

fields.description:
Returns changelog events visible to the logged-in session after applying feature-flag,
payment-plan, script-version, and publish-date filters; `new_only` limits results to the last
12 months.
fields.name: changelog

fields.description:
Returns notification channels for a site the current session can access, optionally filtered
by type and sorted by a derived destination value rather than raw setup_data.
fields.name: channelsList

fields.description:
Runs the cheapest preflight check for install flows, deriving the registrable domain, whether
the current session can access or create the site, and whether the script is already present.
fields.name: checkPermission

fields.description:
Runs the full lambda-backed installation audit for a URL and device, returning redirect-aware
errors, warnings, infos, and admin-only diagnostics when available.
fields.name: checkScript

fields.description:
Returns how many additional snapshots would exceed the viewer's quota for a proposed create
operation; this is an overage count, not a boolean.
fields.name: checkSnapshotsQuota

fields.description:
Runs the expedited probe used during install flows, returning page title, redirect/login
hints, domain access checks, and quota impact without the full scripted audit.
fields.name: checkTitle

fields.description:
Returns the shared country dropdown values used by product forms; this is a static helper
list with country names and codes, not account-specific data.
fields.name: countries

fields.description:
Returns per-day CTA metrics for one CTA addon across an inclusive Unix-timestamp date range;
requires the `ctas:view` capability and also works for allowed shared sessions.
fields.name: ctaResult

fields.description:
Returns the home-dashboard aggregate for one accessible site. The resolver requires the
`home:view` capability, validates `site_id` against the current session, and compares the
requested window against the provided previous window.
fields.name: dashboard

fields.description:
The viewer's primary card on file (single-card model). Null when there is no
card — the checkout UI then falls back to collecting one. The payment method
id is intentionally not exposed.
fields.name: defaultPaymentMethod

fields.description:
Returns one recorded error occurrence for a site. Access is gated by the errors-view
capability, and some session-derived fields may be redacted when the related recording is
outside the viewer's retention window.
fields.name: error

fields.description:
Returns a page-number based list of individual occurrences for one fingerprint. Results
include per-occurrence permissions that determine whether the linked recording can still be
viewed or upgraded into view.
fields.name: errorList

fields.description:
Returns the total number of individual error occurrences for one fingerprint within the
requested timeframe. This mirrors `error_list` filtering without returning the paged records.
fields.name: errorListTotal

fields.description:
Returns one snapshots folder by id for the current user; access is restricted to snapshot
folders on sites the session can view.
fields.name: folder

fields.description:
Returns the current user's folders for one site and folder type; results are
permission-filtered to allowed sites and sorted case-insensitively by title.
fields.name: folders

fields.description:
Returns one funnel by id for normal or shared sessions. Shared links only resolve their own
funnel and record a view when accessed successfully.
fields.name: funnelDetail

fields.description:
Returns funnels the current session can view, optionally scoped to one site. Results use an
opaque cursor that accumulates seen ids for infinite scroll, and omitted `site_id` excludes
funnels from deleted sites.
fields.name: funnelList

fields.description:
Returns funnel counts and conversion rates for the requested site and range. Access requires
funnel view permission, validates every non-visit step against the site, and includes both an
overall summary and the same funnel broken down by the requested time unit.
fields.name: funnelResult

fields.description:
Returns every accessible funnel on the site that references any of the requested goals. Access
is gated by goal-view permission rather than funnel-view permission.
fields.name: funnelsUsingGoals

fields.description:
Returns Google Analytics properties visible to the current session; shared sessions and
restricted-site sessions resolve to an empty list instead of partial account data.
fields.name: gaProperties

fields.description:

matching occurrences fall inside the requested range.

Result of an `updateSubscriptionItems` mutation. `kind` is `UPDATED` — the
subscription was updated directly. When the prorated charge needs authentication
(SCA), `clientSecret` is set so the client confirms the PaymentIntent in-app.
Otherwise `url` redirects to our success page (or, as a last resort, Stripe's
hosted invoice page).
